message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on a Viper vehicle security system set, classified by essential character of the remote control key fobs. The key fobs are radio remote control apparatus under heading 8526.92. Subheading 8526.92.10 covers radio remote control apparatus, other, for the 8526.92 group, with 8526.92.50 as the remaining "other" provision.

HTSUS 8526.92: "Radio remote control apparatus: Other." Within it, 8526.92.10 is "Radio remote control apparatus: Other: Printed circuit assemblies" and 8526.92.50 is "Other". The 10-digit statistical code is 8526.92.5000.

Because the set's essential character comes from the key fobs, GRI 3(b) applies and the set takes the classification of the fobs. I chose 8526.92.5000 over the printed-circuit-assembly line because the fobs are complete devices, not circuit assemblies.
